content.content:
Applies once to the dependent's recorded content, read against all three prerequisites in depends_on. Nothing runs at this layer: a reviewer applies the criteria below to the recorded documents and reports the finding.

1. Applicability: the check applies only to a dependent that carries decision content. If the dependent's recorded content is the skeleton placeholder (`<placeholder>`), empty, or otherwise carries no commitment to licence, the criterion is not met — fail naming the dependent and the placeholder or missing element, and let no empty text pass as licence.

2. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: no element of the dependent contradicts that prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it departs from.

3. Edge use, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: in the dependent, find the element whose soundness that prerequisite carries. Fail naming the prerequisite when the dependent contains no such element; an unused recorded edge is a finding, not a licence.

Which element is at issue is what the check discovers at check time; nothing is pre-named here, so rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides leaves the criteria intact.
content.rationale:
The dependent is one prose commitment about the order in which opening writes — the draft's record last, so a failed open leaves no record naming a workspace — read against three prerequisites that are all inline. szvotxpq and xqzstoyo are inline prose (`text`), so those two edges are natural-to-natural and take that cell's gate check. rqtowtqn is an inline requirement sentence (`ears`), so it is structured, and that edge lands in the structured-to-natural cell, which the matrix lists as `default` — the gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix. The flag is reported with this gate: the cell has no dedicated eval file yet, and the gate form is the matrix's stated fallback until one exists. The dependent is inline prose, so the child is natural whichever parent is read; nothing runs and no artifact path is claimed.

One evaluation carries the three edges because the ordering answer is one answer read three ways. The surface (szvotxpq) says what opening does and, in the same document, reserves what a failed open leaves behind; the registry (rqtowtqn) fixes that a record is exactly one document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json`, found only by scanning that directory; the workspace node (xqzstoyo) fixes that the workspace path is derived from the record's handle and from nothing else, and that the record carries the workspace as a reference. The order of the writes is what those three together leave open and what the dependent settles: a record written last is a record whose workspace already exists, and a record the directory does not name is a record that is not there. Splitting would licence the same sentence three times, once per part of one licence.

Criterion 1 is the applicability the licence pass needs, and it is why this gate is not vacuous. A licence check over a skeleton's placeholder finds no element to contradict, so it would pass with nothing to pass on: a green over an unwritten decision, blind to the content being absent rather than sound. Criterion 1 fixes when the check may be applied at all — only to a recorded dependent carrying decision content — and fails, naming the placeholder, while the dependent is still a skeleton. It constrains nothing the decision may say: any content that commits to something satisfies it, so it survives a rewording of the dependent and adds no rule the prerequisites do not state.

Criterion 3 exists so no recorded edge passes vacuously. The evaluation gates the dependent's use of each prerequisite, not merely the absence of a clash with a prerequisite nothing in the dependent invokes; the three edges are the dependent's whole licence, so an edge the dependent never reaches is a finding. Which element fails, and against which prerequisite, is the check's output, never part of the criterion.

What each prerequisite carries into the check. The surface fixes that opening writes one record per named node, in the state `open`, each in its own workspace, reports handle and path, and writes nothing of the graph; its own closing paragraph puts "what a failed workspace creation or record write leaves behind" deliberately outside itself. A dependent that settles that reserved residual question by placing the record write after the workspace write contradicts nothing the surface says; a dependent that had opening land the record, write graph state, or write anything before the argument surface is answered would be read against those clauses. The registry fixes the record's storage and discovery: exactly one JSON document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json`, the filename the handle, the document the whole record, and the stored records enumerated only by scanning that directory, so that a handle the directory does not name is a record that is not there. A dependent that left a failed open's trace in an index or a second file, or that made a record's presence decidable by anything but the scan, would contradict it. The workspace node fixes where a draft's working copy lives and what a record says about it: under one per-user root outside the repository, at a path derived from the record's handle and nothing else, with the record naming the workspace as a reference, and with the node itself declining to create a workspace, remove one, or decide what a missing one means. A dependent that derived the path from anything but the handle, or that placed the record's workspace reference at a path the derivation does not give, would contradict it.

Not fixed and not demanded here: the mechanism that makes the record write last (temporary file, rename, order of calls, unwinding on the failure paths), what a failed open prints, which exit status it uses, whether a workspace left behind by a failed open is removed, and how a retry behaves. Each is a separate commitment, and the licence check presupposes no decision beyond the three recorded prerequisites. The criterion names no element of the dependent and no function, path, verb or message the dependent does not itself state, so rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides leaves the gate intact.
